units.literal: Earlier, academician Dou Mengzheng had drafted Qian Liu's appointment edict and was demoted to subprefect of Penglai; the Emperor summoned Zhuan into the Hanlin and sent Chongzheng commissioner Li Zhen to ask the chancellors: "Zhuan is Chancellor Xiao Qing's son-in-law—should the Secretariat discuss whether this is permissible?"

units.zh: 夏四月丁未，以宣徽院使、右衛上將軍趙縠權知青州軍州事，以宣徽院副使韋堅權知本院事。
units.en: On dingwei in the fourth month of summer, Zhao Gu, Xuanhui Court commissioner and Right Guard senior general, was made acting commissioner for Qingzhou's military and prefectural affairs; Xuanhui Court deputy commissioner Wei Jian was made acting head of that court.
units.literal: On dingwei in the fourth month of summer, Xuanhui Court commissioner and Right Guard senior general Zhao Gu was made acting Qing prefect military and prefectural commissioner; Xuanhui Court deputy commissioner Wei Jian was made acting head of that court.

units.zh: 甲寅，以刑部郎中、充史館修撰竇專為翰林學士。
units.en: On jiayin, Dou Zhuan, Ministry of Punishments director and History Office compiler, entered the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: On jiayin, Ministry of Punishments bureau director and History Office compiler Dou Zhuan was made Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 壬寅，殺捧聖都軍使李行德、十將張儉，滅其族。
units.en: On renyin, Li Xingde, military commissioner of the Pengsheng Capital Army, and Zhang Jian, a Ten-Commander, were executed and their families wiped out.
units.literal: On renyin, Li Xingde, military commissioner of the Pengsheng Capital Army, and Zhang Jian, a ten-commander, were killed and their clans exterminated.

units.zh: 己巳，秘書少監姚顗為左散騎常侍，以太子左諭德陸崇為右散騎常侍，以兵部郎中蕭希甫為左諫議大夫，前幽州節度判官呂夢奇為右諫議大夫，以鄴都副留守孫嶽為潁州團練使。
units.en: On jisi Yao Hui became Left Regular Attendant; crown prince mentor Lu Chong became Right Regular Attendant; Xiao Xifu of Military Affairs became Left Remonstrator; Lü Mengqi, former Youzhou aide, became Right Remonstrator; Sun Yue, Yedu deputy regent, became Ying training commissioner.
units.literal: On jisi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yao Hui was made Left Regular Attendant; the crown prince's Left Mentor Lu Chong was made Right Regular Attendant; Bureau of Military Affairs director Xiao Xifu was made Left Remonstrator; former Youzhou military commissioner's aide Lü Mengqi was made Right Remonstrator; Yedu deputy regent Sun Yue was made Yingzhou training commissioner.

units.zh: 庚申，以三司使、行工部尚書張延朗為兗州節度使。
units.en: On gengshen Zhang Yanlang, three departments commissioner, became Yanzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On gengshen Commissioner of the Three Departments, acting Minister of Works Zhang Yanlang was made Yanzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 〈（《契丹國志》：時契丹日益強盛，遣使就唐求幽州，以處盧文進。）〉
units.en: (The 《Records of the Khitan State》 says the Khitan were growing stronger and asked Tang for Youzhou for Lu Wenjin.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Records of the Khitan State》 says: At that time the Khitan grew daily stronger and sent envoys to Tang to ask for Youzhou to settle Lu Wenjin.)〉

units.zh: 楊彥溫據河中作亂，自通率師討平之，授河中節度使。
units.en: When Yang Yanwen seized Hezhong, Zitong marched against him, crushed the revolt, and was made commissioner of Hezhong.
units.literal: Yang Yanwen held Hezhong in rebellion; Zitong led troops to suppress and pacify him and was appointed military commissioner of Hezhong.

units.zh: 初，自通既平楊彥溫，代末帝鎮河中，臨事失於周旋，末帝深銜之。
units.en: After he crushed Yang Yanwen, Zitong replaced the Last Emperor as governor of Hezhong. He handled affairs clumsily, and the Last Emperor nursed a deep grudge.
units.literal: At first, after Zitong had pacified Yang Yanwen he replaced the Last Emperor in garrisoning Hezhong; in handling affairs he was deficient in tact, and the Last Emperor deeply resented him.

units.zh: 己卯，以工部侍郎任讚為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、左諫議大夫、充匭使閻至為工部侍郎充職。
units.en: On jimao Ren Zan became left regular cavalier and Yan Zhi minister of works.
units.literal: On jimao, Minister of Works Ren Zan was made Left Regular Cavalier; Privy Council academician, Left Remonstrator, and Pouch commissioner Yan Zhi was made Minister of Works filling the post.

units.zh: 壬寅，夔州節度使楊漢章移鎮雲州，以北京馬步軍都指揮使兼欽州刺史張敬達為鳳州節度使。
units.en: On renyin Yang Hanzhang moved from Kuizhou to Yun and Zhang Jingda of Beijing became Feng commissioner.
units.literal: On renyin, Kuizhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was transferred to Yun prefecture; Beijing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Qin prefecture military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made Feng prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙午，以隨駕馬軍都指揮使、宣州節度使安從進為陝州節度使。
units.en: On bingwu An Congjin, escort horse commander, became Shan commissioner.
units.literal: On bingwu imperial escort horse-army commander, Xuanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was made Shanzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 以吏部郎中李穀充樞密直學士。
units.en: Personnel bureau director Li Gu was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Li Gu, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 壬子，以隨駕步軍都指揮使藥彥稠為邠州節度使。
units.en: On renzi Yao Yanchou became Bin commissioner.
units.literal: On renzi imperial escort foot-army commander Yao Yanchou was made Binzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 以知保大軍軍州事高允韜為檢校太保。
units.en: and Gao Yuntao of Baoda was made Grand Guardian.
units.literal: Gao Yuntao, who held Baoda army and prefecture affairs, was made Grand Guardian.
